newsitem.title: USA: Trigen to build cooling system in Kansas.
newsitem.headline: Trigen to build cooling system in Kansas.

text.p: Trigen Energy Corp said on Friday its Trigen-Kansas City Energy Corp unit was awarded a tentative contract to develop a cooling system for several buildings in downtown Kansas City.

Trigen said it received letters of intent from officials of the city government, Jackson County and the U.S. General Services Administration to purchase chilled water for 11 buildings in the Missouri city.
The contract was expected to be signed by February 1. Trigen said it was proceeding with a detailed design of the system while working to finalize the deal.
Trigen said its total investment in the system was expected to reach $25 million by 2000.
